question.text: Saraswati Distressed Opportunities Fund, a Cat I AIF, is considering whether to register itself under a specific sub-category of Cat I AIF to act as a Resolution Applicant under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. Which sub-category must the fund register under?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per pp.263 and 517-518, a Special Situation Fund is a sub-category under Category I AIF, has to be registered as such, invests in special situation assets, and may act as a resolution applicant under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016. The Trap: Infrastructure, SME and Venture Capital Funds are Cat I sub-categories with separate investment mandates; the workbook's IBC resolution-applicant treatment is associated specifically with the Special Situation Fund sub-category. Note: Special Situation Fund registration is the route the workbook identifies for an AIF that intends to act as a resolution applicant under the IBC, 2016.
